chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

Whoever sets right matters between himself and Allah, Allah sets right matters between him and the people; and whoever sets right the affairs of his Hereafter, Allah sets right for him the affairs of his world; and whoever has a preacher for himself, Allah has a Guardian over him.

key_terms.أَصْلَحَ: to set right, to rectify, to make good
key_terms.حَافِظٌ: a guardian, a protector, one who watches over
key_terms.وَاعِظٌ: a preacher, a moral guide, one who admonishes

ai.seo_question: How does improving one's relationship with God affect relationships with other people?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) articulates the principle of *islah* (rectification), establishing that vertical piety serves as the foundation for horizontal social harmony, a concept central to Shia ethical theology. This reciprocal relationship underscores that self-accountability (*muhasabah*) not only secures divine protection but also ensures that worldly affairs are aligned with spiritual goals, reflecting the holistic nature of human existence in Shia thought.
